name: Acute intracranial hemorrhage
target_definition: Presence and subtype of acute intracranial hemorrhage on non-contrast head CT, classified into five subtypes: epidural, intraparenchymal, intraventricular, subarachnoid, and subdural.
population: Adults presenting with suspected acute intracranial hemorrhage, evaluated by non-contrast head CT.
expected_output: Any-hemorrhage risk and per-subtype findings for epidural, intraparenchymal, intraventricular, subarachnoid, and subdural hemorrhage.
limitations: Acute recognition task on non-contrast CT, not a clinical diagnosis or treatment recommendation.
Radiologist-labeled subtypes are the reference; inter-rater agreement metrics are not uniformly documented.
The dataset represents a retrospective challenge cohort and may not reflect all populations or acquisition protocols.
